sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Chemical Experiments is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello again, friend. There are many people in Tarkov who are in need of my assistance. For example, a local chemist recently asked me to provide him with a hose for his equipment. This is too easy of a task for my men, and they simply do not have the time. Could you help this local from customs?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Stash a Corrugated hose in the med lab on Customs

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
- 550 Dollars
  - 578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Excellent. The local has sent his gratitude."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Corrugated hose | 1 | Required | N/A | Stashed item |
In this quest you have to stash a Corrugated hose at any table in the experiments area on the second floor of the the laboratory building on Customs.
